nameEn: Restaurants and mobile food service activities
description: This class includes the provision of food services to customers, whether they are served while seated or serve themselves from a display of items.
includes: restaurants and cafes: full-service and limited-service food service
food stalls: stands, carts, food trucks
mobile food services: catering vans, food trucks
preparation and serving of meals from railway dining cars
excludes: preparation of food for takeaway (restaurants that primarily sell takeaway), see 5610
